_doc: Measured, function-first tag records for prefabs in ACTIVE USE (NOT all 1087). Reviewed tag records. THE RULE: placement/selection code may branch ONLY on a field whose source is 'measured-geometry' or 'measured-usage' AND whose confidence is 'high'. Names (and name-derived package_inventory.json) are for DISCOVERY only, never selection.

_sources.measured-geometry: Derived from the asset itself (mesh/renderer/collider bounds, mesh normals, vertex distribution). Trust when the heuristic is validated against ground truth.
_sources.measured-usage: Derived from how the pack's own authored modules/scenes place the piece (offsets, served quadrant, connector truth). Trust.
_sources.name-hint: Parsed from the filename. A candidate to VALIDATE, never to select on.

_confidence: high | low. A measured tag from a coarse/unvalidated heuristic (e.g. per-side perimeter touch) is 'low' until hardened. Selection ignores 'low' (treats it as a hint).

function.doc: What the piece DOES, not what it is named. WallTrim is stairSideTrim_DECORATIVE, not a closure; convex/concave walls are rounded*, not corners.

pivotConvention.doc: Measured pivot family; validate against the _O_/_M_/_E_ suffix.

originOffset.doc: Pivot-to-geometry offset; placement must compensate (pivots are arbitrary on saved set-pieces).

footprintCells.doc: Walkable footprint in cells (w x d).

footprintCoverage.doc: Does the shape fill its bounding rectangle? Octagon/rounded = partial (corners empty). Used to clear ONLY cells the shape covers, never the bounding box.

heightUnits.doc: Vertical extent in units. level = heightUnits / levelHeight.

faceNormal.doc: Visible face direction for edge pieces (walls). Area-bucketed mesh normal.

shapeClass.doc: convex/concave family = rounded; never place rounded at a square corner.

perimeterSides.doc: Per-side classification of the connection-plane geometry. open = a continuous gap where floor continues through (C's mouth). blank_wall = a tall closed vertical wall-like face (throne back). connectable = low/stepped/flush. NOT per-side vertex touch (that false-scored everything interior).

placementMode.doc: Derived from perimeterSides. Any 'open' side => room_entrance (abut a doorway; connecting room at the matching elevation). Else any 'blank_wall' side => wall_abutting (seat that side against the MIDDLE of a wall span; front faces the room). Else all connectable/closed => interior (may sit mid-room). NEVER from the name.

connectors.doc: Authored-usage exits = high; raw child-renderer edge scans = low (trim/caps over-close edges).

riseVariant.doc: Stair rise N (1..4); validate against the _N suffix by measured rise.

fillHole.doc: fill = raised (mass above connection plane); hole = sunken (mass below).

cornerBaseQuadrant.doc: For corner pieces: floor-cell quadrant served at yaw 0. COMP_Wall_01_O_corner = NorthWest.

exampleRecord._note: TARGET values (what a correct, hardened measurement should produce for concave). The CURRENT step_library_index.json mis-measures this as placementMode=interior (perimeterConnectionMask=15) because the per-side touch heuristic cannot see the open C. Fix the perimeter-opening measurement, then this is the output.
